anira.doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH, split per engine: this root file only includes engines/<engine>/presets-ci.json (so a preset edit re-triggers one workflow, not five). Each visible <engine>-<platform>-<arch>-<kind>[-debug] preset drives the build (cacheVariables) AND carries its CI + naming metadata in vendor.anira, which engine-meta jq-parses into the CI matrix. There is no ci-matrix.json. Canonical artifact/job name = vendor.anira.name; the ARM token is aarch64 on Linux, arm64 elsewhere, arm64-v8a for Android ABIs.
